time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t * fps)
coordinates: pixels, x right, y down, origin top-left of the full-resolution frame. *_bgref_px columns = position minus camera shift (frame-0 background coordinates).
description: Grayscale (contrast-boosted, shadows clipped to black) near-top-down drone view of a full outdoor basketball court in portrait orientation. Top of image = one basket, bottom = the other. Bottom half: a rebound - the ball comes off the bottom rim at frame 0, bounces once on the court (frame 13) and is caught by player B (dark shirt), who then moves/dribbles to the right holding it; player A (white shirt) walks/jogs up-left away from the basket. Player C stands almost motionless near the top basket with arms raised. Sun from upper-left: every object casts a long hard shadow toward lower-right.

camera.motion: small slow drift only: total shift <= ~8 px (dx 0..+5, dy 0..-8 px vs frame 0); per-frame shifts in tracks/camera_shift.csv (phase correlation, confirmed by 5 static line-corner templates to ~1 px)
camera.perspective: slight tilt: the court is wider at the bottom of the image than at the top (bottom lane 639 px wide vs top lane 615 px, +3.9%; sidelines converge upward). Players near the bottom are seen slightly obliquely. Treat as planar for the annotator convention (one scale).

ball.frames_visible: 0-43 (0 overlaps rim), 64-68, 86-90; partly/fully hidden in B's hands/body 44-63, 69-85
ball.distinguish: only ball in play; light-grey disc ~33-35 px tall (bright part ~27 px wide, right side shaded dark)

ball_shadow.distinguish: dark ellipse ~37x32 px, lower-right of the ball; meets the ball at the bounce

player_A_white.distinguish: white shirt, dark hair, bottom-left on the left lane line at start (~(765,3530)); walks up-left to ~(470,3195) by frame 90

player_B_dark.distinguish: black shirt, starts inside the bottom lane at ~(1040,3222) jumping/reaching up, catches the rebound at frame 26 and moves right to ~(1355,3415) by frame 90, crossing the right lane line ~frames 84-90

player_C_top.moves: almost static (centre wobble <= ~5 px, arms raised over head)
player_C_top.distinguish: only person in the top half, just below the top basket inside the top lane

bottom_hoop.note: seen from above; rim is above the floor so its image position is parallax-shifted

court_lines.note: line centres measured on the median background (frame-0 coordinates) with intensity profiles (scripts/court_lines.py)

light_pole_shadows.note: two long diagonal pole shadows from the left edge ending in lamp-head shadows at ~(760,1335) and ~(755,3140)

tree_shadow.note: large dark tree shadow over the left of the court, y ~1400-2950

bottom_hoop_stanchion.note: pole/base below the bottom baseline, x ~1040-1100, y ~3700-3800, plus its shadow

events.event: clip starts with the ball just off the bottom rim (overlapping the ring) moving up-right in the image; B under the basket reaching up, A on the left lane line
ball bounces on the court: ball-shadow image distance minimum (22.5 px; 27 px at 12, 36 px at 14) and abrupt change of the ball's image velocity (~(3.5,-8.4) px/frame before, ~(0.8,-2.5) after)
B's hand reaches the ball (ball blob merges with hand); from frame 27 the ball moves with B (held)
ball held/dribbled by B, mostly hidden; visible again at B's lower-right 86-90
A moves continuously up-left (net (-297,-330) px); B moves continuously down-right then right (net (+305,+199) px); C stays put
